policy.boundarySummary: The v1.3 corpus keeps raw object denial, permission bypass, lifecycle cleanup, packaged metadata mismatch, Safe downgrade, cross-package ownership denial, foreground disclosure, and stable-denied boundary coverage aligned with P15-04 through P15-22.

positiveCases: P15-04 imports packaged live UI provider POC evidence as partial only
P15-11 keeps UI automation media release text future-only without runtime authority
negativeCases: missing packaged ui capability rejects before live UI provider dispatch
raw Activity, View, Window, Context, Binder, and Java object handles remain denied
abuseCases: packaged metadata mismatch tries to open live UI without reviewed capability
background or scheduled execution tries to create hidden UI without disclosure
runtimeGuards: UiHandle remains opaque and ResourceRegistry-owned
provider destroy and close paths must clean live UI resources before promotion
promotionPreconditions: packaged relaunch, task-removal cleanup, crash recovery, disclosure, Android 15+, security, types, docs, and migration gates must pass
P15-24 packaged aggregate smoke must include undeclared live UI capability denial
capabilities.rollback: Keep live UI at provider POC, disable any packaged live UI promotion switch, and keep raw Android UI objects denied.

positiveCases: P15-05 through P15-07 import overlay provider, OEM matrix, and packaged smoke evidence as partial only
P15-11 records overlay docs and declarations without promoted authority
negativeCases: overlay creation remains denied without exact capability and Android overlay permission
raw WindowManager, LayoutParams, FloatyWindow, View, Context, and Java object handles remain denied
abuseCases: SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW metadata mismatch attempts silent overlay creation
permission revocation followed by stale overlay handle update
runtimeGuards: overlay sessions remain ResourceRegistry-owned
closeAll and provider destroy must remove owned overlay resources
promotionPreconditions: Android 12/15+ granted-permission archives, OEM notes, disclosure/stop action, cleanup stress, and packaged install-run evidence must pass
P15-24 packaged aggregate smoke must include undeclared overlay capability and permission-denial cases
capabilities.rollback: Keep overlay promotion disabled and keep ui.overlay as provider POC or stable denial until permission, disclosure, and device evidence passes.

positiveCases: P15-08 imports accessibility lifecycle and selector/action evidence as partial only
P15-11 keeps accessibility docs and declaration notes future-only
negativeCases: missing service or capability rejects before action dispatch
raw AccessibilityService, AccessibilityNodeInfo, UiObject, Context, Binder, and selector handles remain denied
abuseCases: packaged metadata mismatch tries to enable accessibility silently
stale selector handle attempts to operate after service disconnect
runtimeGuards: selector/action payloads remain JSON-safe descriptors
service disconnect and provider destroy must invalidate owned handles
promotionPreconditions: Android 12/15+ service-enabled archives, settings round-trip, task-removal/relaunch, disconnect denial, and safe diagnostics must pass
security, types, docs, migration, and packaged aggregate gates must stay aligned
capabilities.rollback: Keep accessibility provider promotion disabled and keep service, node, and Java object handles denied.

positiveCases: P15-09 imports Activity-owned MediaProjection contract evidence as partial only
P15-11 keeps screenshot/media projection release state unpromoted
negativeCases: capture remains denied without reviewed prompt ownership and exact capability
raw MediaProjection, VirtualDisplay, ImageReader, Intent, Context, Surface, and Java objects remain denied
abuseCases: background capture tries to bypass prompt or disclosure
captured buffer attempts to escape scoped output ownership
runtimeGuards: capture sessions require app-owned prompt and ResourceRegistry cleanup before promotion
foreground disclosure and stop action remain promotion preconditions
promotionPreconditions: Android 12/15+ prompt/capture archives, packaged APK evidence, task removal/relaunch/crash evidence, and Safe downgrade proof must pass
P15-24 must include capture denial and disclosure downgrade cases before release use
capabilities.rollback: Keep media projection and screenshot capture promotion disabled while preserving existing denial diagnostics.

positiveCases: P15-10 imports advanced image and packaged OCR contract evidence as partial only
P15-11 keeps image/OCR examples and declaration notes future-only
negativeCases: OCR model/provider mode remains denied without exact capability and packaged evidence
raw Bitmap, Mat, Image, OCR engine handle, Context, and Java objects remain denied
abuseCases: unbounded image transform or OCR workload attempts quota bypass
capture-to-OCR flow attempts to skip capture disclosure
runtimeGuards: image and OCR outputs must stay scoped and JSON-safe
quota/leak stress and Safe downgrade remain required before promotion
promotionPreconditions: live transform/matching archives, packaged scoped output, OCR model/provider archives, quota stress, disclosure, Safe downgrade, and type/docs gates must pass
P15-24 must include metadata mismatch and scoped output denial for image/OCR
capabilities.rollback: Keep image/OCR promotion disabled and fall back to existing scoped image operations and denial diagnostics.

positiveCases: P15-12 imports JSON-safe task database mutation contract evidence as partial only
P15-22 keeps task/device/media docs and declarations future-only
negativeCases: task database mutation remains denied without exact capability and owner mapping
raw TimedTask, WorkManager, AlarmManager, JobScheduler, Context, PendingIntent, and Java objects remain denied
abuseCases: cross-package task row mutation attempts owner bypass
wall-clock scheduler mutation attempts to bypass prompt and rollback policy
runtimeGuards: future task ids must be opaque Node-owned records
owner-scoped cancel/list behavior and Safe downgrade remain required
promotionPreconditions: live mutation archives, owner/id mapping, schema rollback, packaged mutation smoke, cross-package denial, disclosure, and Safe downgrade must pass
P15-24 must include task database metadata mismatch and missing-capability denial
capabilities.rollback: Keep task database mutation disabled and preserve read-only or denied task compatibility behavior.

positiveCases: P15-13 imports task schema migration and rollback contract evidence as partial only
P15-14 imports packaged task scheduling smoke contract evidence as partial only
negativeCases: packaged task scheduling remains denied without reviewed metadata and owner-scoped task rows
legacy task visibility downgrade cannot expose cross-package rows
abuseCases: corrupt schema recovery attempts to keep partially promoted task rows
packaged task relaunch attempts duplicate or orphaned scheduled runners
runtimeGuards: schema migrations must be reversible and owner-scoped
packaged task cleanup must cover process death, task removal, relaunch, and Safe downgrade
promotionPreconditions: live migration tests, corruption recovery, backup/restore, packaged rollback, relaunch cleanup, and security/type/docs sync must pass
P15-24 must include process-death/relaunch and metadata mismatch task cases
capabilities.rollback: Keep packaged task scheduling disabled and restore legacy visibility downgrade behavior.

positiveCases: P15-15 imports JSON-safe IntentTask/broadcast provider contract evidence as partial only
P15-16 imports packaged broadcast trigger/remove smoke contract evidence as partial only
negativeCases: broadcast registration and trigger delivery remain denied without exact capability and reviewed receiver policy
raw Intent, IntentFilter, PendingIntent, BroadcastReceiver, Bundle, Uri, package-list, and Java objects remain denied
abuseCases: exported receiver metadata attempts to bypass explicit review
trigger payload attempts to carry raw Android handles or unbounded private data
runtimeGuards: future descriptors must be bounded JSON records with owner-scoped remove behavior
receiver export policy and payload validation remain promotion preconditions
promotionPreconditions: live registration, manifest synthesis, exported receiver policy, trigger payload validation, owner cleanup, packaged trigger/remove smoke, cross-package denial, and Safe downgrade must pass
P15-24 must include undeclared broadcast capability, exported receiver denial, and metadata mismatch cases
capabilities.rollback: Keep IntentTask and broadcast provider promotion disabled and keep raw broadcast Android objects denied.

positiveCases: P15-17 imports notification ownership and foreground disclosure contract evidence as partial only
P15-18 imports settings/power OEM and background-launch matrix evidence as partial only
negativeCases: notification post/cancel and foreground ownership remain denied without exact capability and Android permission evidence
request-ignore-battery-optimizations, wake locks, exact alarms, background-launch bypasses, and raw Android handles remain denied
abuseCases: foreground service disclosure attempts hidden or unowned notification channels
OEM power prompt attempts to mutate device settings without reviewed user action
runtimeGuards: owned notification ids remain ResourceRegistry-backed
power/settings operations stay dry-run or denied until reviewed prompts and rollback proof exist
promotionPreconditions: packaged post/cancel, foreground disclosure/stop action, Android permission matrix, OEM matrix archives, background launch policy, Safe downgrade, and raw-object coverage must pass
P15-24 must include notification permission denial and power metadata mismatch cases
capabilities.rollback: Keep notifications and power/settings promotion disabled and retain stable permission-denied diagnostics.

positiveCases: P15-19 imports real recorder session promotion contract evidence as partial only
P15-20 imports packaged recorder/media stress contract evidence as partial only
negativeCases: recorder.start and recorder.stop remain fail-closed without exact media.recording capability and runtime microphone evidence
raw MediaRecorder, AudioRecord, ParcelFileDescriptor, Uri, Context, foreground service handle, raw file descriptor, and Java objects remain denied
abuseCases: packaged recorder tries to start without visible microphone disclosure
crash or task removal attempts to retain temporary recorder output
runtimeGuards: recorder session handles must be ResourceRegistry-owned before promotion
temporary output cleanup, deterministic stop, and quota limits remain required
promotionPreconditions: runtime microphone prompt ownership, foreground disclosure/stop action, scoped session cleanup, packaged stress, Safe downgrade, and raw-object security coverage must pass
P15-24 must include packaged recorder denial, cleanup, and metadata mismatch cases
capabilities.rollback: Keep real recorder and packaged recorder promotion disabled while retaining status-only or denial behavior.

positiveCases: P15-21 records MediaStore/playback as stable-denied for v1.3
P15-22 keeps release-facing task/device/media text aligned with the stable-denied decision
negativeCases: playback, playlists, scanFile, MediaStore query/mutation/open-file, and broad media-library permissions remain denied
raw MediaPlayer, AudioTrack, ContentResolver, MediaStore cursor, MediaScannerConnection, Uri, ParcelFileDescriptor, file descriptors, Context, and Java objects remain denied
abuseCases: broad READ_MEDIA or MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permission tries to bypass scoped provider review
MediaStore mutation attempts cross-package or broad-library writes without owner-scoped policy
runtimeGuards: current allowed media surface remains read-only audio status and scoped mediainfo
future scoped provider must declare exact capabilities, ownership, permission matrix, privacy, rollback, Safe downgrade, and raw-object denial
promotionPreconditions: A future scoped provider decision archive is required before any playback or MediaStore promotion
P15-24 must preserve stable-denied playback and MediaStore denial cases
capabilities.rollback: Keep MediaStore and playback stable-denied for v1.3 and preserve existing denial diagnostics.

positiveCases: P15-11 synchronizes UI automation media docs, examples, declarations, security, errors, TESTING, and CI without promotion
P15-22 synchronizes task/device/media docs, examples, declarations, security, errors, TESTING, and CI without promotion
negativeCases: docs and declarations must not advertise callable promoted authority beyond executable evidence
release notes must not convert partial provider POC evidence into promoted compatibility claims
abuseCases: TypeScript declarations overclaim raw Android object access or promoted methods
migration docs imply Pro parity for stable-denied or future-only providers
runtimeGuards: release-facing docs remain tied to generated gate reports
declarations keep provider_poc_not_promoted and stable_denied language until promotion gates pass
promotionPreconditions: P15-25 type declaration profile gate and P15-26 migration/pro comparison gate must pass before closeout
Any future promoted declaration must point at matching runtime, device, packaged, security, and migration evidence
capabilities.rollback: Revert release-facing docs and declarations to future-only or stable-denied text if executable evidence changes.

positiveCases: P15-23 imports the P14-33 corpus baseline while keeping critical Phase 15 manifest work planned
packaged-capable provider families require aggregate smoke before release evidence can be cited
negativeCases: undeclared packaged capability or metadata mismatch must reject before provider dispatch
Safe profile downgrade must remove packaged provider authority and preserve denial diagnostics
abuseCases: packaged APK tries to reuse stale reviewed metadata after provider policy changes
downgrade or rollback path attempts to leave provider resources active
runtimeGuards: critical P15-23 manifest mapping remains planned until aggregate release gates close
P15-24 packaged aggregate smoke is the next release-evidence gate
promotionPreconditions: P15-24 packaged aggregate smoke, P15-25 type profiles, P15-26 migration/pro comparison, and P15-27 closeout must pass
No critical provider authority may be promoted from the host security corpus alone
capabilities.rollback: Block promotion on any security regression, restore Safe/default denial, and keep critical manifest entries planned until release closeout.
